caption: The drawing consists of two main views of an object rendered in fine black lines on a yellowed, off-white background. The top view shows a rectangular shape with slightly trapezoidal sides, depicted with parallel straight lines and four small protrusions at each corner. This view is plain, with just a few simple shading lines near the top edge. The lower view is a frontal elevation of a bench-like object. It has a gently arched backrest with dashed lines indicating possible internal structure or stitching. The side edges of the backrest curve softly upward toward the ends. The frame of the bench includes five visible turned legs, three in the front and one at each end, featuring decorative carved elements. Three shaded rectangles represent vertical support pieces directly beneath the seat of the bench. The armrests connect to the legs on both ends, showing curved and angled details. The drawing uses only black lines and cross-hatching for detail and shading, with no additional colors or textures.
title: Sofa
